## Problem

Increase the return of a marketing campaign by targeting offers to the customers most likely to respond.

## Approach

Exploratory analysis of customer profiles and modeling to prioritize who should receive the campaign.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [pandas]{.tag} [scikit-learn]{.tag} [CRM]{.tag} [Logistic Regression]{.tag} [K-Means]{.tag} [SHAP]{.tag}

## Results

A carefully preprocessed Logistic Regression outperformed XGBoost (**ROC-AUC 0.933**, PR-AUC 0.737, 92% recall). With the threshold chosen for profit (0.45), the campaign goes from **−3,046 MU to +279 MU**, capturing **90% of the maximum possible profit**. K-Means segmentation identified a Premium group with a 31.9% response rate.
